styles.name: Azure Editorial
styles.description: Cool slate-blue canvas, crisp light surfaces, deep navy ink, cobalt blue accents, and classic editorial serif headings paired with geometric sans and monospace metadata.

styles.name: Editorial Roastery
styles.description: Warm paper surfaces, deep charcoal ink, condensed uppercase display type, hairline dividers, and vermilion accent inspired by artisanal roastery storefronts.

styles.name: Kinetic Obsidian
styles.description: Deep obsidian canvas, translucent elevated glass surfaces, expressive editorial serif headlines, soft pill geometry, and warm amber highlights inspired by modern consumer app launches.

styles.name: Playful Bookclub
styles.description: Sun-bright yellow, candy pink, electric cyan, and deep violet surfaces paired with chunky rounded display headings, crisp geometric body copy, handwritten margin notes, and elastic spring hover physics.

ui.name: Bookclub App Badges
ui.description: Paired App Store and Google Play store badge buttons with elastic hover squash, optional outline styling for dark surfaces, and crisp white-label SVG fallbacks.

ui.name: Bookclub Bouncy CTA
ui.description: Two-piece split pill CTA button with detached square icon badge, elastic overshoot hover tilt, optional anchor-arrow rotation, and GSAP SplitText character bounce.

ui.name: Bookclub Intro Splash
ui.description: Full-screen page-load overlay: a thick organic brush stroke covers the viewport, a logo mark pops in with an elastic spring, then the stroke wipes away with GSAP DrawSVG. Removes itself when done, can be switched off, sped up or held, and skips itself for reduced motion.

ui.name: Bookclub Mascot Popup
ui.description: Circular emblem trigger that reveals a spring-animated speech bubble popover with twitching ear accents and an embedded bouncy CTA.

ui.name: Bookclub Pill Button
ui.description: Rounded navigation pill button with elastic squash hover, GSAP SplitText character bounce, and optional animated ear accents on the active state.

ui.name: Bookclub Slider Controls
ui.description: Previous and next circular navigation control pair with elastic hover squash and disabled state styling.

ui.name: Bookclub Social Button
ui.description: Circular social icon button with elastic background squash and counter-rotating inner icon bounce on hover, supporting base and big sizes.

ui.name: Editorial Button
ui.description: 1:1 condensed uppercase storefront CTA button with solid, dark, ghost, and light variants, responsive viewport-scaled sizing, 3px corner radius, and optional lighten blend mode.

ui.name: Editorial Product Spec Card
ui.description: High-fidelity wireframe editorial product spec card with 1.5px currentColor outline, 0.6s color-invert hover, fluid typography, 2-column spec table, and optional photo tile variant.

ui.name: Fullscreen Search Overlay
ui.description: Full-viewport navy search overlay with 3 interactive steps: live autocomplete suggestions, dual-month date range picker with duration pills, and dashed-ring destination selector.

ui.name: Magnetic Button
ui.description: Cursor-tracking magnetic pill CTA button powered by motion/react springs (stiffness 150, damping 15), optional 32px circular icon badge, and reduced-motion support.

ui.name: Editorial Marquee Ticker
ui.description: 1:1 wireframe announcement bar with 1.5px currentColor outline, 10px radius, 20x24 upward arrow rows, responsive condensed uppercase display typography, and optional continuous scrollX marquee mode.

ui.name: Rolling CTA Button
ui.description: Vertical rolling-label editorial CTA button and circular arrow/close trigger with primary, secondary, white, small, fixed, and dashed-outline hover-invert states.

ui.name: Slide-Over Cart Drawer
ui.description: 1:1 editorial bag drawer: 440px white panel sliding in from the right, condensed uppercase title, grey free-shipping goal strip with ink progress bar, thumbnail line items with hairline quantity stepper, oversized subtotal, and full-width condensed checkout bar.

ui.name: Trip Search Bar
ui.description: Three-segment search bar with query, date period, and destination selectors plus square submit button; supports clickable trigger mode and live input mode.

ui.name: Voyage Package Card
ui.description: Editorial travel package card with scrubbed parallax image, corner badge tag, title, category pills, dotted-divider spec list with starting price, and upward navy invert hover.

ui.name: Waitlist Input Card
ui.description: High-fidelity dark-obsidian waitlist form card with translucent email field, smooth cubic-bezier focus states, optional feedback opt-in checkbox, interactive 5-star idea rating block, and full-width pill submit control.

sections.name: Alternating Story Split
sections.description: Stacked alternating 50/50 editorial rows pairing GSAP-scrubbed parallax imagery with serif headings, body copy, hairline rules, and rolling CTA buttons.

sections.name: Bookclub Benefits Stage
sections.description: Pale-yellow rounded 16:9 showcase stage with centered emblem, breathing organic wave SVG backdrop, and five floating benefit pills powered by GSAP elastic entry and InertiaPlugin momentum hover physics.

sections.name: Bookclub Books Carousel
sections.description: Horizontal Smooothy parallax book showcase with sinusoidal card tilt, automatic luminance-aware text contrast, twitching ear hover accents, genre pill tags, and circular arrow controls.

sections.name: Bookclub Box Sequence
sections.description: Pinned 300svh scroll-scrubbed canvas frame sequence inside a pale-blue rounded viewport with SplitText handwritten callouts, mascot popover, and App Store / Google Play badges.

sections.name: Bookclub Choice Winners
sections.description: Yellow rounded award showcase with Smooothy horizontal parallax slider, circular author portraits, starburst year badges, blurred upcoming-vote card, heart plop-in, and GSAP emoji rain.

sections.name: Bookclub Exclusive Showcase
sections.description: Framed anthology feature card with star rating badge, drop-shadow, tilted author callout pill, handwritten reader quotes, decorative badges, and embedded bouncy CTA.

sections.name: Bookclub FAQ Accordion
sections.description: Soft-blue accordion FAQ section with WAAPI height expand/collapse animations, rotating plus/minus icons, breathing wave SVG backdrop, bouncy CTA, and mascot popover.

sections.name: Bookclub Floating Header
sections.description: Fixed three-column navigation header with pill links, bouncy CTA, social buttons, scroll-reactive side slide-up, and full-screen spring-clipped mobile menu drawer.

sections.name: Bookclub Genre Showcase
sections.description: Bright-pink rounded genre list where hovering swaps display type to handwritten script, parts neighboring items, and reveals four mouse-parallax cover stacks.

sections.name: Bookclub Gift Feature
sections.description: Gifting spotlight with scroll-scrubbed SVG textPath curved headline, copy + bouncy CTA column, press logo tiles, and elastic pop-in tilted package visual.

sections.name: Bookclub Hero
sections.description: Sun-yellow rounded hero section with SplitText word-bounce headline, handwritten margin note, bouncy CTA, floating mascot popover, breathing organic SVG backdrop, and looping box frame canvas.

sections.name: Bookclub How It Works
sections.description: Soft-pink rounded process band with four overlapping color-coded step cards that fan out on mouse hover using GSAP elastic spring physics, plus floating mascot badge and bouncy CTA.

sections.name: Bookclub Promo Banners
sections.description: Layered tilted promotional ribbon banners with wavy organic vector fills and GSAP ScrollTrigger elastic snap-in motion.

sections.name: Bookclub Wave Footer
sections.description: Deep-violet newsletter footer with overlapping black copyright bar, GSAP ScrollTrigger parallax box reveal, app store badges, social buttons, and validated mailing-list signup.

sections.name: Collection Split Showcase
sections.description: High-fidelity 8/4 collection switcher with dual-synced Swiper (visual slider + EffectFade details via Controller), GSAP ScrollTrigger horizontal product rail, and circular arrow navigation.

sections.name: Editorial Columns Footer
sections.description: Three-column editorial footer pairing a brand mark and stacked dual CTAs with rolling-label navigation columns and an accreditation/legal bottom bar.

sections.name: Editorial Dark Footer
sections.description: Asymmetric dark editorial footer with staggered link columns, floating-label underline newsletter form, 1.8s viewport-gated stop-motion photo card, studio address, oversized social row, and rounded back-to-top bar.

sections.name: Editorial Manifesto Chapter
sections.description: Full-viewport editorial chapter section with a pinned running header, staggered uppercase serif display lines that rise into view on scroll, and an offset manifesto body column.

sections.name: Editorial Mission Split
sections.description: Full-bleed editorial mission narrative with inline condensed tagline, display blend CTA, opposing GSAP ScrollTrigger parallax on background and centered 535:668 portrait, flanking callouts, and coordinates stamp.

sections.name: Editorial Spotlight Banner
sections.description: Full-bleed dark-scrim parallax story banner with category label, top-right archive link, and sticky white-surface feature card with secondary CTA.

sections.name: Editorial Storefront Hero
sections.description: 1:1 storefront hero: giant split-character headline over a scaling parallax photo, scroll-pinned Shop Now button that shrinks into place beside the description, and an outlined mood block with a 3-product spec grid and arrow ticker.

sections.name: Featured Packages Grid
sections.description: Responsive 3-to-4 column editorial showcase grid with centered serif heading and parallax travel package cards featuring hover inversion.

sections.name: Floating Pill Navbar
sections.description: Centered frosted-glass floating pill navigation bar with Georgia serif wordmark, minimal section links, blur-drop entrance motion, and a Contact pill CTA that morphs into a Copied confirmation state.

sections.name: Heritage Manifesto Band
sections.description: Centered deep-navy rounded manifesto card with monospace eyebrow surtext and oversized serif statement animated via GSAP ScrollTrigger.

sections.name: Interactive Product Match Quiz
sections.description: Multi-step guided recommendation quiz with hairline progress track, oversized condensed display prompt, 2-column tactile option grid, ghost and solid navigation buttons, and weighted result card with retake flow.

sections.name: Staggered Manifesto & Steps
sections.description: High-fidelity light editorial section pairing three staggered giant condensed display words animated via GSAP split-character expo.out reveal with numbered 01-03 steps, scrub-parallax 311:364 media inset, and uppercase subscription block.

sections.name: Minimal SaaS Footer
sections.description: Ultra-clean single-row SaaS footer pairing a serif wordmark, vertical hairline divider, subtle editorial tagline, and motion view-reveal.

sections.name: Newsletter Prefooter
sections.description: Deep-navy centered newsletter signup prefooter band with oversized editorial serif headline, lead copy, and rolling secondary CTA button.

sections.name: Orbital Crest Wheel
sections.description: Light editorial showcase with a continuously spinning ring of heraldic shield crests, scroll-velocity spin acceleration, radial pointer push-pull physics, frosted horizon blur scrim, and scroll-morphing display headlines.

sections.name: Parallax Destination Carousel
sections.description: Horizontal Swiper destination showcase with GSAP real-time image parallax per slide, editorial heading, View All CTA, and circular arrow controls.

sections.name: Partner CTA Banner
sections.description: Rounded editorial two-row grid banner pairing an oversized serif headline and rolling CTA on the top-left with body copy on the bottom-right and responsive mobile CTA placement.

sections.name: Physics Stats Pit
sections.description: Full-viewport interactive stats section with a Matter.js 4-column physics ball pit, procedural goo-masked column textures, live eased counters, staggered display headline, and a responsive 2x2 mobile tile grid.

sections.name: Rays Waitlist Footer
sections.description: Full-viewport waitlist footer with a Three.js volumetric light-rays shader radiating from a pointer-lit emblem tile, staggered word reveals, interactive witty email validation bubble, and three-column legal row.

sections.name: Right Rail Editorial Navbar
sections.description: High-fidelity 90px right-edge sticky navigation rail with 33px animated hamburger/close icon, 90deg rotated shipping ticker, cart/account/locale controls, and 460px slide-out accordion drawer.

sections.name: Spiral Deck Hero
sections.description: Full-viewport cinematic hero with a layered top blur scrim, three-column navigation bar, viewport-fitted staggered display headline, and an interactive Three.js 3D spiral card deck.

sections.name: Split Dropdown Navbar
sections.description: Fixed floating editorial header with brand wordmark, rolling-label links, animated category dropdown with dashed-ring icons, search trigger, CTA pill, and slide-down mobile drawer.

sections.name: Spotlight Stat Band
sections.description: Full-bleed oversized serif stat section with ease-out count-up animation, cursor-following radial spotlight, hairline animated divider, and three staggered narrative columns.

sections.name: Story Chances List
sections.description: Light editorial chapter sheet with a pinned running header, uppercase display headline featuring an inline rotating masked emblem crest, and a numbered 3-column story list with scroll reveal and pointer-tracking photo parallax.

sections.name: Video Expand Hero
sections.description: Full-viewport editorial hero with centered serif headline, integrated three-segment search bar, dark scrim, and GSAP-scrubbed parallax background media.

sections.name: Spotlight Waitlist Hero
sections.description: Atmospheric waitlist hero featuring a cursor-lit continuous serif marquee, optional live member count pill, pointer-following spotlight headline, email signup card, and interactive 5-star idea rating.

templates.name: Bookclub Landing Template
templates.description: Full-page playful bookclub shell applying root viewport fluid typography (--rk-bc-size-font), overflow-x: clip for sticky scroll sequences, fixed floating header slot, 11 rounded-corner section slots, and overlapping negative-margin footer slot.

templates.name: Editorial Storefront Template
templates.description: Full-page editorial storefront shell featuring a fixed 90px right-hand desktop navigation rail (calc(100vw - 90px) content column) collapsing cleanly to a 60px top bar on mobile, with ordered slots for hero, quiz, showcase, story, manifesto, footer, and slide-over drawer.

templates.name: Kinetic Story Template
templates.description: Full-bleed dark editorial storytelling page shell with isolated stacking context, ordered chapter slots (hero, manifesto, story, stats, orbit, footer), and a scroll-triggered floating bottom CTA pill.

templates.name: SaaS Waitlist Landing Template
templates.description: Full-width dark SaaS waitlist landing shell with fixed top floating pill navigation region, ordered vertical content slots (spotlight, waitlist hero, extra), and closing footer slot.

templates.name: Voyage Editorial Template
templates.description: Full-page editorial travel showcase shell with floating header slot, fullscreen search overlay slot, surface-layered main stack, sticky prefooter reveal, and structured footer region.

pages.name: Bookclub Landing Demo Page
pages.description: Full 12-band playful bookclub landing page composing the landing template with floating header, hero, monthly books carousel, step cards, scroll box sequence, genre list, momentum benefits stage, FAQ accordion, curved gift feature, promo ribbons, choice winners, exclusive spotlight, and parallax footer.

pages.name: Kinetic Story Demo Page
pages.description: Full composed dark obsidian storytelling reference page assembling the kinetic story template with 3D spiral card deck hero, editorial manifesto chapter, story chances list, Matter.js physics stats pit, orbital crest wheel, and WebGL rays waitlist footer.

pages.name: Editorial Storefront Demo Page
pages.description: Full composed editorial storefront reference page assembling the right-rail storefront template with hero, interactive quiz, split collection showcase, mission split, kinetic manifesto, dark footer, and live slide-over bag drawer.

pages.name: Voyage Editorial Demo Page
pages.description: Full composed voyage editorial demo page assembling the voyage editorial template with floating dropdown navbar, search overlay, video hero, horizontal parallax carousel, featured packages grid, heritage manifesto, story splits, spotlight banner, partner CTA, newsletter prefooter, and structured footer.

pages.name: SaaS Waitlist Landing Demo Page
pages.description: Full composed dark SaaS waitlist reference page assembling the SaaS waitlist template with floating pill navbar, interactive waitlist hero, pointer spotlight stat band, and minimal SaaS footer.
